interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B
interfaces.value: fun m n => Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a m * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho m ^ n

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D
interfaces.value: fun m n h => Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p n h / Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B m n

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.F0
interfaces.type:
∀ (m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (h : ℝ),
      ↑m ≤ h →
        h < ↑m + 1 →
          ∀ (n : ℕ),
            0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a m ∧
              0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho m ∧
                Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho m < 1 ∧
                  0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B m n ∧
                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p n h = Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K n h ∧
                      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p n h =
                          Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B m n *
                            (1 + Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.eps m n * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.q m +
                              Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R m n) ∧
                        Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D m n h =
                            Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K n h / Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B m n ∧
                          Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D m n h =
                            1 + Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.eps m n * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.q m +
                              Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R m n

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.F0_small_cells
interfaces.type:
(∀ (n : ℕ), Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R 1 n = 0) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R 2 n = 0) ∧
    Shao.OQ4.RademacherSpectralPairing.zeroMode 2 0 = -(1 / 3) ∧
      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R 2 0 = -1 / (3 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a 2) ∧
        Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R 2 0 ≠ 0

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.F0_zero_time
interfaces.type:
∀ (m : ℕ),
  1 ≤ m →
    ∀ (h : ℝ),
      ↑m ≤ h →
        h < ↑m + 1 →
          Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p 0 h = 1 ∧
            Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K 0 h = 1 ∧
              Shao.OQ4.RademacherSpectralPairing.zeroMode m 0 =
                if Even m then (-1) ^ (m / 2) / Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m else 0

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.F1
interfaces.type:
0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.C_U ∧
  ∀ (m : ℕ),
    1 ≤ m →
      ∀ (h : ℝ),
        ↑m ≤ h →
          h < ↑m + 1 →
            ∀ (n : ℕ),
              Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m ^ 2 ≤ Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N n →
                |Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R m n| ≤
                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.C_U *
                      Real.exp
                        (-Real.pi ^ 2 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N n / Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m ^ 2) ∧
                  |Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D m n h - 1 -
                          Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.eps m n * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.q m| ≤
                      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.C_U *
                        Real.exp
                          (-Real.pi ^ 2 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N n / Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m ^ 2) ∧
                    |Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D m n h - 1| ≤
                      Real.pi ^ 2 / (4 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m ^ 2) +
                        Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.C_U *
                          Real.exp
                            (-Real.pi ^ 2 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N n / Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m ^ 2)

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K
interfaces.value: fun n h => Shao.OQ4.killedMass Shao.OQ4.RademacherCosine.law h n 0

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.Q1
interfaces.type:
∀ (m_ n_ : ℕ → ℕ) (h_ : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ m_ k) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), ↑(m_ k) ≤ h_ k) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), h_ k < ↑(m_ k) + 1) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H (m_ k)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.t (m_ k) (n_ k)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
            (∀ (k : ℕ),
                0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a (m_ k) ∧
                  0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho (m_ k) ∧
                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho (m_ k) < 1 ∧
                      0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B (m_ k) (n_ k) ∧
                        Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p (n_ k) (h_ k) = Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K (n_ k) (h_ k) ∧
                          Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p (n_ k) (h_ k) =
                              Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B (m_ k) (n_ k) *
                                (1 +
                                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.eps (m_ k) (n_ k) *
                                      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.q (m_ k) +
                                  Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R (m_ k) (n_ k)) ∧
                            Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k) =
                                Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K (n_ k) (h_ k) /
                                  Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B (m_ k) (n_ k) ∧
                              Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k) =
                                  1 +
                                      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.eps (m_ k) (n_ k) *
                                        Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.q (m_ k) +
                                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R (m_ k) (n_ k) ∧
                                (n_ k = 0 →
                                  Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p (n_ k) (h_ k) = 1 ∧
                                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K (n_ k) (h_ k) = 1)) ∧
              (∃ K_time,
                  ∀ (k : ℕ),
                    K_time ≤ k →
                      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H (m_ k) ^ 2 ≤ Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) ∧
                        1 ≤ n_ k ∧
                          |Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.R (m_ k) (n_ k)| ≤
                              Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.C_U *
                                Real.exp
                                  (-Real.pi ^ 2 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) /
                                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H (m_ k) ^ 2) ∧
                            |Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k) - 1 -
                                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.eps (m_ k) (n_ k) *
                                      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.q (m_ k)| ≤
                                Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.C_U *
                                  Real.exp
                                    (-Real.pi ^ 2 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) /
                                      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H (m_ k) ^ 2) ∧
                              |Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k) - 1| ≤
                                Real.pi ^ 2 / (4 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H (m_ k) ^ 2) +
                                  Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.C_U *
                                    Real.exp
                                      (-Real.pi ^ 2 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) /
                                        Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H (m_ k) ^ 2)) ∧
                Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Real.pi ^ 2 / (4 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H (m_ k) ^ 2)) Filter.atTop
                    (nhds 0) ∧
                  Filter.Tendsto
                      (fun k =>
                        Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.C_U *
                          Real.exp
                            (-Real.pi ^ 2 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) /
                              Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H (m_ k) ^ 2))
                      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                    Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k)) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds 1) ∧
                      Filter.Tendsto
                          (fun k =>
                            Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K (n_ k) (h_ k) /
                              Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.B (m_ k) (n_ k))
                          Filter.atTop (nhds 1) ∧
                        (∃ K_pos,
                            ∀ (k : ℕ),
                              K_pos ≤ k →
                                0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k) ∧
                                  0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p (n_ k) (h_ k) ∧
                                    0 < Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K (n_ k) (h_ k) ∧
                                      Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p (n_ k) (h_ k)) -
                                              Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a (m_ k)) -
                                            Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) *
                                              Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho (m_ k)) =
                                          Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k)) ∧
                                        Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K (n_ k) (h_ k)) -
                                              Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a (m_ k)) -
                                            Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) *
                                              Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho (m_ k)) =
                                          Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k))) ∧
                          Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.D (m_ k) (n_ k) (h_ k)))
                              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                            Filter.Tendsto
                                (fun k =>
                                  Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p (n_ k) (h_ k)) -
                                      Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a (m_ k)) -
                                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) *
                                      Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho (m_ k)))
                                Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
                              Filter.Tendsto
                                (fun k =>
                                  Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.K (n_ k) (h_ k)) -
                                      Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a (m_ k)) -
                                    Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N (n_ k) *
                                      Real.log (Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho (m_ k)))
                                Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.T0
interfaces.type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ m →
    0 ≤ Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.q m ∧
      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.q m ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / (4 * Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m ^ 2) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ), |Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.eps m n| = 1

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.definition_bridges
interfaces.type:
∀ (m : ℕ),
  Shao.OQ4.RademacherSpectralPairing.alpha m 0 = Shao.OQ4.RademacherScalarBounds.u m ∧
    Shao.OQ4.RademacherSpectralPairing.beta m 0 = Shao.OQ4.RademacherScalarBounds.z m ∧
      Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a m =
          1 / Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m *
            (Real.cos (Shao.OQ4.RademacherScalarBounds.u m) / Real.sin (Shao.OQ4.RademacherScalarBounds.u m)) ∧
        Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.a m = Shao.OQ4.RademacherScalarBounds.a m ∧
          Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho m = Real.cos (Shao.OQ4.RademacherScalarBounds.z m) ∧
            Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.rho m = Shao.OQ4.RademacherScalarBounds.rho m

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.p
interfaces.value: fun n h => (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => Shao.OQ4.RademacherCosine.law).real (Shao.closedStrip h)

interfaces.name: Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.t
interfaces.value: fun m n => Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.N n / Shao.OQ4.RademacherS2Assembly.H m ^ 2
